d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a single curved ahoge, held in a low ponytail by a large black ribbon. Narrow, sharp purple eyes with a calm, mature expression on a face appearing in the late teens or early twenties. A slender build wearing a black gothic dress with a ruffled off-the-shoulder neckline, a high thigh slit, and a layered, voluminous skirt. Accessories include a small white floral brooch at the chest, black fingerless gloves, black high-heeled pumps with ankle straps, and a large, ornate white skeletal scythe.
